held.rationale: Go 1.27.0 is a one-day-old minor, not a security patch. The lint contract in AGENTS.md builds golangci-lint v2.6.0 with GOTOOLCHAIN matching go.mod; golangci-lint binaries built with go1.26 do not support go1.27 (golangci/golangci-lint#6643). go1.27 support landed in golangci-lint v2.13.0, which also carries a large linter delta (errcheck 1.10→1.20, exhaustruct deprecation). A Go bump is therefore a coupled go.mod + AGENTS.md + lint-pin qualification, not a mechanical pin. Freshness policy targets validation within 7 days and hard-fails at 14; holding a 1-day-old x.27.0 is inside the window. Frontier consensus (Fable + Sol) unanimously chose HOLD_GO.

Test-ReleasePins.ps1 and verify-worker-image.sh require those files to move with the image. Org still offers 2.337.0 (gh api orgs/melodic-software/actions/runners/downloads linux-x64). GHCR multi-platform index digest sha256:e5496277be5d09bc968b3d64911b74e219ac4a3f2edce956a3ecf9271bea1ef4 was confirmed from the GHCR OCI index Docker-Content-Digest header and the tagged GHCR package version. linux-x64 archive sha256 70920811a4f8ad4328818682bca5c6469c1c942fab52448868071d0063816613 matches the org download checksum, the GitHub release asset digest, and an independent download hash. The drift table HARD FAIL on 2.337.0 is a regex false positive: Test-DependencyFreshness.ps1 treats a release body matching (?i)\bcritical\b|\bsecurity\b|CVE-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]+ as critical, and v2.337.0 notes include Dependabot bumps of System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs and System.Security.Cryptography.ProtectedData. The upstream release (https://github.com/actions/runner/releases/tag/v2.337.0) is not a critical/CVE: no CVE identifier, no security advisory, routine SDK/tooling/dependency updates plus VSock secret notifier, websocket retry NRE fix, DAP debugger masking, HTTP Retry-After, and Docker/Buildx updates.
